text: At Velvera, sustainability is not an afterthought — it's part of our design philosophy. From ethical sourcing to green logistics, every step is optimized to minimize environmental impact without compromising performance or innovation.

- Carbon Neutral Packaging
  - All Velvera packaging is made from 100% recycled paper, printed with soy-based inks, and manufactured in carbon-neutral facilities.
- ** Plastic-Free Experience**
  - Zero plastic across packaging — including tapes, wraps, and trays. Instead, we use biodegradable fiber-based cushioning and compostable seals.
- ** Trade-In & Recycling Program**
  - Recycle your old Velvera or any brand’s device responsibly through our TakeBack+ program.
  - Instant trade-in value at velvera.com/trade-in (https://velvera.com/trade-in)
  - Certified e-waste recycling partners
  - Earn up to ₹1,500 in green credits
- Energy Efficiency
  - All Velvera chargers and power adapters exceed 90% energy efficiency standards and are designed to minimize phantom power drain.
- Conflict-Free Materials
  - All key components (tantalum, tin, tungsten, and gold) are sourced from conflict-free and ethically audited supply chains.
- Eco-Friendly Accessories
  - Accessories like phone cases and watch bands made from bio-polymer, plant-based leather, and recycled ocean plastic.

- Certification: EPEAT Gold | Description: Awarded to all Velvera tablets for meeting highest environmental criteria
- Certification: Energy Star | Description: Certified on all Velvera chargers, power banks, and audio devices
- Certification: RoHS Compliant | Description: Restricts use of hazardous substances in manufacturing
- Certification: ISO 14001 | Description: Environmental management systems certified across all production facilities
- Certification: RE100 Member | Description: Committed to sourcing 100% renewable electricity by 2027
Did You Know?
Every Velvera One unit ships with 30% less packaging volume than the previous generation — reducing shipping emissions by 18% per unit.

- Net Zero Manufacturing by 2028
  - Fully transition to renewable energy in all manufacturing sites globally.
- Circular Design Commitment
  - Launch modular smartphones and tablets with user-replaceable parts by 2026.
- Certified Carbon Offset Program
  - Offer opt-in offsets for all online purchases, contributing to reforestation and clean energy projects.

For more on our sustainability roadmap, visit:
velvera.com/sustainability (https://velvera.com/sustainability)
